acceptance_predicates.description: Supported setup/run/compare/report commands resolve the initialized project and bounded result paths.
Commands validate installed/discovered tools and active catalog compatibility before execution.
Missing or stale dependencies explain the exact install/discover/select next action.
Live, offline, and mock modes remain explicit and missing development authentication is warning-only.

definition_of_done: Command integration, regression, and locked workspace gates pass

inputs.description: Initialized project, tool inventory, and active catalog contract.

outputs.description: Project-aware setup, run, compare, and report behavior.

gates.description: A project can progress from readiness to benchmark and result/report commands using selected catalog entries.
